thread:
lina: 25m until change window. Quick pre-launch check — any outstanding release notes or pin decisions?

rahul: I have one last minor schema migration for logs pipeline, non-breaking, already tested on staging. MigrationID: mig-2026-03-21-12.

pm-kate: please add a note to release notes: "Logs schema migration (non-breaking)" and include rollback plan if consumer errors surface.

deploy-bot: @lina deploy-bot: Pin approval requested for `api-v2.14.1` at 1769876543. Use `/pin approve` to lock, `/pin abort` to cancel. Current pins: none.

lina: rahul — any chance migration could impact request tracing ingestion?

rahul: Shouldn't. We kept backward-compatible fields. Still, I'll put a canary on trace-writer to route 1% traffic for 10m first.

sre-ana: I'll raise tracing ingestion alerts to higher sensitivity for the next 30m and keep autoscaler min=1 for the canary to avoid cold-start noise.

pm-kate: Add rollback criterion: if trace drop >5% or any consumer error spikes (>=3) within 10m, roll back migration and revert config.

lina: agreed. Also, patch release notes with migrationID and the canary gating details.

rahul: canary routing applied: trace-writer -> 1% for 10m. Monitoring started.

deploy-bot: Change window scheduled: 1769876820. Canary routing recorded. :white_check_mark:

rahul: no errors observed after 8m. Traces stable. I'll proceed with the full migration at T+12m.

pm-kate: tagging release-notes/draft.md with "logs-schema: mig-2026-03-21-12 (canary 1% then full)"

lina: about pin — since no model changes, no pin needed. Focus on migration and monitoring.

deploy-bot: Pin request canceled for `api-v2.14.1` at 1769876990 per /pin abort.

sre-ana: monitoring steady. Increasing log retention for next 2h for post-launch debugging.

rahul: full migration applied at 1769877100. No regressions in first 10m.

lina: great. Proceeding with change window. Please keep an eye on tracing and consumer metrics for 1h.

pm-kate: pushing final release notes now and will send out the launch memo.

lina: thanks all, closing thread. :rocket:
